expectations.text: A new Slack-related interface (port) is added to server/src/vendor/shared/adapters.ts
The concrete implementation (the code that performs the HTTP call to the webhook) lives in a new file in its own new directory under server/src/adapters/<name>/
expectations.evidence: Concrete code in server/src/adapters/notifications/slack.ts (own new adapters/<name>/ directory, contains the fetch).

expectations.text: A mock implementation of the new port is added to server/src/adapters/mocks.ts
container.ts registers the new adapter with a getter and a ContainerOverrides entry
expectations.evidence: container.ts: ContainerOverrides.notifications plus async notifications() accessor that reads SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL from secrets (async method instead of a getter, same role).

expectations.text: ReviewService reaches the notifier only through this.container and contains no fetch/axios/Slack SDK call or import of the concrete adapter
expectations.evidence: ReviewService only calls NotificationService, which uses await this.container.notifications(); no fetch or concrete adapter import in either service.
